text:
elaine: Heads-up — PR #7423 ready for review, contains the hotfix for the memleak in the serving runtime. Need 2x LGTM before the 21:30 PT cutoff or we'll rollback the staging cut. cc @mason @kai :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mason: on it, will do a quick smoke pass in the next 10. if anything blocks I'll flag immediately.

kai: reading now. if tests pass i'm happy to second-approve. can someone confirm there's a migration?

elaine: no DB migration. tiny change: avoid holding KV cache refs, added a safe-free path. tests updated. diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7423

sara: quick note — if we hit merge but latency increases, we should toggle the canary to 10% and gate traffic. I'll prep the rollback playbook just in case.

ryan: left a small nits comment on the GC loop — minor, doesn't block. +1 once addressed but i won't block the merge if it's just formatting.

ophelia: I'm OOO for 2hrs but can shadow-approve if needed after 20:50 PT. adding myself to the approver-rotation.

mason: local smoke done, no obvious regressions. running stress for 5m now.

merge-bot: PR #7423 — CI: success ✅  unit: 204 passed, e2e: 18/18, perf: baseline (no regression).

kai: approved — LGTM.

mason: approved — LGTM.

elaine: awesome, thanks both. plan: merge at 21:20 PT, monitor latency and error-rate dashboards for 15m, then promote to staging cut. Sara — can you keep rollback flag ready?

sara: yup — rollback plan: revert PR, hotfix route disables kv-caching temporarily, and promote previous image. I have the runbook snippet:```steps:
1) /revert PR 7423
2) kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=image:redwood/runtime:staging-2026-03-17
3) toggle feature flag: kv-cache -> off
4) notify #incidents and eng-sre
```

elaine: merge done at 21:20 PT. merge-bot kicked off the cut.

deploy-bot: Release job started — build 7423 -> image push in progress. job id: deploy-2026-175987.

ryan: monitoring now, dashboards look green. tailing logs for errors.

ophelia: saw a small spike in 1s p99 at +2m but it settled by +7m. looks okay.

elaine: great. leaving the canary at 10% for 30m then we'll ramp to 50% if stable. thanks everyone for quick eyes. :tada:

sara: recorded outcome and annotated the runbook. marking this as closed unless anyone sees a new regression.

mason: nice work, team.

elaine: closing thread — will open follow-up if any fallout.
